children: Excelerate Energy Inc. (EE) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on November 04, 2026.

On November 4, 2026, Excelerate Energy, Inc. (the "Company") issued a press release announcing its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. A copy of the earnings press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K, which is hereby incorporated by reference into this Item 2.02.

The information furnished pursuant to this Item 2.02, including Exhibit 99.1, shall not be deemed to be "filed" for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), and will not be incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, unless specifically identified therein as being incorporated therein by reference.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1888447/000119312526447504/ee-20261104.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1888447/000119312526447504/0001193125-26-447504-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
